archetype: Organic & Earthy with High-Contrast Fintech structural elements
design_philosophy: Shopify + Stripe + Uber + Plaid + TikTok for agriculture. Bold, trustworthy, modern, premium, practical, African-rooted, global-standard.

rules.h1: font-heading text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-extrabold tracking-tight text-[#18181B]
rules.h2: font-heading text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl font-bold tracking-tight text-[#18181B]
rules.overline: font-sans text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-[#198754]

spacing_and_layout.grid_system: Grid cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-6 lg:gap-8 for standard layout. Dashboard uses grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-4 lg:grid-cols-12 tight gaps (gap-4 or gap-6).

cards.escrow_card: bg-white rounded-2xl border-l-4 border-l-[#F59E0B] shadow-[0_8px_30px_rgb(0,0,0,0.04)] p-6

buttons.primary: bg-[#0F5132] text-white rounded-full px-8 py-3.5 font-semibold shadow-sm hover:bg-[#064E3B] transition-all hover:shadow-md
buttons.secondary: bg-white text-[#0F5132] border border-[#0F5132] rounded-full px-8 py-3.5 font-semibold hover:bg-zinc-50 transition-colors
buttons.accent: bg-[#F59E0B] text-white rounded-full px-8 py-3.5 font-semibold hover:bg-[#D97706] transition-colors
buttons.ghost: text-[#71717A] hover:text-[#18181B] hover:bg-zinc-100 rounded-full px-4 py-2 transition-colors

badges.verified: inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1 rounded-full bg-[#198754]/10 text-[#0F5132] text-sm font-semibold
badges.pending: inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1 rounded-full bg-[#F59E0B]/10 text-[#D97706] text-sm font-semibold
badges.in_transit: inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1 rounded-full bg-blue-500/10 text-blue-700 text-sm font-semibold

inputs.default: bg-zinc-50 border border-zinc-200 rounded-xl px-4 py-3 text-[#18181B] focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#0F5132]/20 focus:border-[#0F5132] transition-all placeholder:text-zinc-400

icons.style: stroke-width 2, rounded edges. Use primary green (#0F5132) for emphasis and active states.

interactions_and_motion.hover: Subtle translate-y (-translate-y-1) on marketplace cards, button background darkening with ease-in-out transition.
interactions_and_motion.page_load: Staggered fade-up (opacity 0 to 1, translate-y 10px to 0) for dashboard widgets and marketplace grid items.
interactions_and_motion.escrow_flow: Use horizontal step connectors with animated progress bars. Green (#10B981) for completed, Amber (#F59E0B) for active current step.

instructions_to_main_agent: Initialize Tailwind config with extended colors (primary #0F5132, accent #F59E0B) and fonts (font-heading: 'Cabinet Grotesk', font-sans: 'Manrope').
Add both 'Cabinet Grotesk' from Fontshare and 'Manrope' from Google Fonts to index.html or global css.
Prioritize data clarity in dashboards: use grid layouts with tight gaps (gap-4 or gap-6) and white cards over a #FAFAFA background.
Style standard Shadcn components to match the 'AgriFlow' vibe: customize with rounded-2xl corners, soft shadows shadow-[0_8px_30px_rgb(0,0,0,0.04)], and zero harsh borders.
Create a custom visual timeline component for the Escrow/Delivery status. It needs to look highly trustworthy.
Never use generic AI purple or teal colors. Stick strictly to the Premium Green, Charcoal, and Gold Accent palette to maintain the African-fintech premium feel.
Ensure ALL interactive elements (buttons, inputs, links, tabs) have descriptive data-testid attributes for automated testing (e.g., data-testid='buyer-marketplace-link').

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text over primary green buttons is #FFFFFF for high contrast. Focus states must have an explicit ring ring-2 ring-[#0F5132]/20.
accessibility.reduced_motion: Wrap custom animations with CSS media queries or framer-motion settings to respect prefers-reduced-motion.
